decisions.structure: CSharp Arena and Text emitters consume committed numeric/value contracts and supply pointer/length/capacity or borrowed Text views. Native typed value consumers delegate Arena arithmetic and fatal checks to per-owner helpers and Text slicing to one checked producer.
decisions.branches: Arena signed nonnegative sizes, zero/power-of-two alignment, padding/end overflow, keep/grow and byte bounds; Text start/length bounds before start/end UTF8 boundaries, with the end-of-text read exclusion.
decisions.logic: Preserve canonical width/sign, source declaration identity and heap ownership for Arena; Text slicing returns a borrowed pointer/length without allocating a new owner. Native helper CFG and CSharp inline CFG are explicit representation adapters. Ownership consumes these values, rather than deciding the operation from source spelling.
decisions.diagnostics: Named current backend provider/consumer boundaries only. Actual previous scoped Arena/Text records are linked for their original domains and epochs; no new failure injection, whole file or boundary-exhaustive runtime result is inferred.
decisions.completionScope: Named current provider/consumer and phase boundary only. This is not a full-file semantic review, new runtime proof, phase closure or additional compiler-stabilization credit.

decisions.structure: CSharp specialized function, callback and runtime helper emitters consume resolved declarations, typed captures and runtime-use flags. Native consumes corresponding reachable typed functions/captures and feature roots before generating CPU/runtime/callback definitions.
decisions.branches: Exact AES owner/receiver/arity, x86 runtime-dispatch feature admission and portable dispatch; direct nonasync user callbacks versus general capture adapters; typed environment values and five runtime context pointer slots; IO/file/process/environment/memory/event use roots.
decisions.logic: Backend definitions are downstream providers for lowered values and lifetime consumers. CSharp tracks mutable emitter flags while Native freezes reachability/root tables; both keep target admission and canonical declaration/type ownership outside private LLVM spelling. Shared runtime context slot ordering remains generated from CSharp authority.
decisions.diagnostics: Preserve existing target/callback admission and missing metadata errors. This names source responsibility, not all helper bodies, physical parallel scheduling, live OS features, platform acceptance or current execution of historical CPU/callback suites.
decisions.completionScope: Named current provider/consumer and phase boundary only. This is not a full-file semantic review, new runtime proof, phase closure or additional compiler-stabilization credit.

decisions.structure: CSharp Ir contains the low-level instruction writer, storage-type guard and current-block termination/phi state. Native emits corresponding instructions from admitted canonical IR, frozen schedules and region reachability; this backend serializer is not a separate lowering or ownership analysis.
decisions.branches: Label resets versus branch/ret/trap/unreachable termination; hoisted allocas; typed load/store, direct/indirect calls, conditional select and join phi placement. Unit storage must be rejected before invalid LLVM reaches assembly.
decisions.logic: Canonical types and owner/lifetime plans supply storage; serializers cannot repair an absent type or invent an owner. CSharp local block state and Native explicit schedule/region tables are separate representations of that boundary, not asserted byte-identical implementation.
decisions.diagnostics: Retain CSharp S006 storage-type checks and Native pre-emission canonical storage admission. The current source association does not newly execute every serializer operation or qualify whole Unit-storage/termination behavior.
decisions.completionScope: Named current provider/consumer and phase boundary only. This is not a full-file semantic review, new runtime proof, phase closure or additional compiler-stabilization credit.

decisions.structure: CSharp enum match/try and diagnostic session emitters consume canonical subject, return, task and mutable snapshot contracts. Native enum control and diagnostic op dispatch consume canonical IR subjects, owner regions and diagnostic runtime tables.
decisions.branches: Payloadless/owned/borrowed enum subjects, continuing versus terminating arms, Result error propagation; diagnostic start/track/snapshot/close and valid mutable snapshot storage, capacity and terminal state.
decisions.logic: Control output preserves the canonical result and payload ownership selected upstream. Diagnostic lifecycle code must not supply semantic ownership decisions or reinterpret private codegen names as source provenance. Existing separate enum and coroutine records retain their bounded proof scopes.
decisions.diagnostics: Keep incompatible Result context, missing mutable snapshot metadata and invalid diagnostic admission errors. No new coroutine/session/enum suite, complete-file equivalence or whole control-flow closure is credited.

decisions.structure: CSharp junctions materialize typed products/captures and Utilities implements locals, transferred-owner sibling cleanup, runtime-value drops and mutable slot lifetime. Native consumes the corresponding typed source/capture/place/return facts through region, callback and ownership emitters.
decisions.branches: Sequential tap/source preservation versus structured product/parallel capture; owned source borrowed into a capture environment; reverse local cleanup excluding loans and exact transferred owner, custom drop, heap backing, task/producer and mapped/source resource families.
decisions.logic: Cleanup is a consumer of canonical ownership facts. Preserve transferred fields and borrowed aliases, release only the actual owning backing, and keep task/producer lifecycle separate from mere pointer serialization. CSharp scope snapshots and Native canonical IR ownership tables are explicit adapters.
decisions.diagnostics: Preserve missing capture metadata and canonical owner/return admission. Existing historical branch/cleanup proofs are linked without current runtime credit or complete-file/ownership-phase certification.
decisions.completionScope: Named current provider/consumer and phase boundary only. This is not a full-file semantic review, new runtime proof, phase closure or additional compiler-stabilization credit.
